text:
maya: Heads up — acme-corp is seeing /toolcall/charge failures in prod, plus duplicate billing. Escalating @jordan @alex

jordan: Which account + a sample payload/response?

maya: Account acme-corp. Sample response (from prod): `400 schema validation error: field \"amount\" expected number, got string`. Their request includes fewshot examples in the system prompt.

alex: If their fewshot has humanized examples like \"$12.50\" that can leak into function args as strings. Do we have the function schema?

maya: Customer-provided function signature: `charge(amount: number, currency: string, idempotency_key: string)`. Prod log shows args: `{\"amount\":\"12.50\", \"currency\":\"USD\", ...}` and stack: `validate_args: TypeError expected number got string`.

jordan: Any routing changes or model rollouts around that time? Older variants sometimes stringify numbers during fncall mapping.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: routed redwood-2.1-v3 (3% traffic) at 2024-11-29T14:20Z to experiment with tool-mapping heuristics.

leah: We also saw p95 latency spike for charge endpoint ~14:22 UTC (~1200ms) which may have caused retries and duplicate charges on client side.

maya: Customer says timeouts triggered retries, so combined with malformed args we ended up with double charges for a few transactions. Need immediate mitigation.

alex: Short-term options: rollback routing to v2, and/or coerce numeric strings to numbers on our tool-input path for charge. Long-term: detect mismatch between examples in prompts and declared function schema and warn.

maya: Repro steps I used locally: 1) Send request with system fewshot: "Example: Charge $12.50 to card X" 2) Observe function call payload: `charge({\"amount\":\"12.50\"})` 3) Validator rejects it. cURL I ran:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.infer/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Example: Charge $12.50 to card ..."}],"functions":[{"name":"charge","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"}}}}]}'
```

leah: +1 to rollback. Also we need an idempotency guarantee on our side so retries don't double-charge even if client retries.

oncall: Acknowledged. Rolling routing back to redwood-2.1-v2 now. Also applying a temporary server-side coercion for charge.amount (numeric strings -> numbers) as a safety patch.

csm_beth: I'll notify the customer: rollback done, we'll follow up with set of mitigations and advise to sanitize examples (prefer JSON-coded examples).

jordan: I'll open ticket CS-4598 with logs, repro steps, and assign to eng-ml + eng-runtime for a proper fix: (1) detect conflicting examples vs function schema and warn; (2) stricter fncall validation + safe coercions; (3) docs update.

maya: Also note docs update: call out that plaintext fewshot examples can leak into tool args. Add sample sanitization and recommend pinning examples as JSON or using explicit tool examples.

alex: One more note: check model-variant mapping rules so function selection isn't influenced by freeform examples. We should surface a warning in responses when examples conflict.

csm_beth: Customer is OK with rollback and patch, wants timeline for permanent fix. Putting this in CS escalation queue.

maya: Thanks all. Closing initial triage here; will follow up in CS ticket with timeline and PR references.
